remarks: Beautiful NYC-style loft condo in the sought-after, renovated hat factory known as Clocktower Close. This stunning loft features 14' ceilings, two-story windows, exposed original wood beams, and a stunning brick wall that adds warmth and charm. The open kitchen/dining area has been renovated with quartz countertops, a subway tile backsplash, large gray tile floor, a new stove/air fryer combo, and a dishwasher. The new chic, modern half-bath just off of the kitchen provides style and convenience on the main level. The upstairs primary bedroom suite is spacious and private and has plenty of closet space and newly installed recessed lighting. Many amenities, including a newly renovated fitness center with sauna and locker rooms, conference room, community game room/lounge and community kitchen, laundry room and landscaped courtyard. Located just 7-minutes from bustling downtown South Norwalk, restaurants, shops, Norwalk beaches, train, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. EXCELLENT CREDIT IS A MUST! Move in/Move out refundable deposit $250, 2 Month Security Deposit, and Liability/Renters Insurance required. All appointments must be confirmed via Showingtime and 24-hour notice is required. Prospective tenants should apply via RentSpree. Available 1/10/25
